import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def signals(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Anchor-dislocation fade for a PEGGED contract in its pre-delisting wind-down.
    Anchor = median close of the prior day excluding the most recent hour (bars t-288..t-13),
    a trailing proxy for the fiat peg. Fade closes that sit > 500 bps from the anchor.
    Closed bars only: every input is at or before bar t. Meaningful ONLY on a pegged
    instrument inside a delisting window; on a free-floating perp it is generic MR (dead rows 2/3/76)."""
    close = df["close"].astype(float)
    anchor = close.shift(12).rolling(276, min_periods=200).median()
    dev = close / anchor - 1.0
    sig = pd.Series(0, index=df.index, dtype=int)
    sig[dev < -0.05] = 1
    sig[dev > 0.05] = -1
    return sig.fillna(0).astype(int)
